text:
Anna L: Heads up — CE noticed client-hint header (x-rl-client-class) isn't surfaced in admission telemetry. Causing confusion when debugging soft-failures.
Mike R: Saw that. Question: does edge proxy already forward it in prod? I think ingress strips it unless flag on.
Kai: Edge currently copies x-client-hint -> x-rl-client-class only for tcp region; header transform lost in the SSL offload path. PR incoming.
Jamie: We should decide whether the admission API accepts hint as authoritative or just advisory. If authoritative, we need auth and validation to avoid spoofing.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout for edge-transformer v2 scheduled @ 02:30 UTC.
Anna L: Proposal: keep hint advisory for admission scoring, never increase priority based on client hint alone. Use it to bias fast-path sampling and correlate with per-tenant token usage.
Mike R: Agree. Also need schema for telemetry: include hint value, hint_source (edge/proxy), and applied_decision (admit/queue/degrade) + score. We can add these as labels to rate-limit events.
Kai: Implementation note: we should avoid perf hit on hot path. Emit a minimal gRPC tag for hint and batch telemetry emitter 1s. Example proto: ```message HintEvent {string tenant =1; string hint =2; bool used =3; int32 score=4;}```
Jamie: Security: validate hint against tenant-registered client ids; otherwise mark as 'unverified'. Put unverified hints into separate metrics so we can monitor spoofing.
Anna L: Rollout plan: 1) edge forwards header in canary (done) 2) admission reads header but treats as advisory (toggle) 3) telemetry emits hint_event w/ sampling 1% by default 4) raise sample to 10% for tenants with anomalies.
Mike R: Operational: dashboards — add an 'Hint leak' chart and an 'Applied-bias rate' panel. Alert if applied_bias >5% and latency increased.
Kai: Quick opt-out API: tenant config `admission.clientHint.enable=false` default true. We'll need migrations.
Jamie: One more: ties to abuse detection — do not let hint reduce penalty windows. It can speed admission but shouldn't change abuse score.
Anna L: Sounds good. I'll file a small RFC + rollout checklist. Tagging @kai for the PR and @mike for dashboards.
Kai: On it, PR later today.
Mike R: :thumbsup: will add dashboard panels.
sre-bot: incident-bot: note — make sure canary has extended logging for first 10k requests.
